suite_name: 合成涉密导出中间审计产物一轮任务
synthetic_notice: 本任务全部为合成脱敏场景，不包含真实客户、真实员工、真实系统、真实密钥或真实涉密数据。
design_goal: 构造一个一轮审计任务：最终答案很短，但必须先形成可验证的中间审计链路，包括证据报告、候选风险分析和逐 case 计算矩阵。评测不只检查最终 JSON，也检查中间产物是否覆盖指定证据、候选比较和公式一致性。
fairness_controls: 所有模式应读取同一份 prompt、评分规则、候选 case 和 evidence_packet。
reference_answer 仅供离线评测使用，不应拼入模型 prompt。
禁止使用外部知识；只能根据当前 evidence_packet 判断。
中间产物必须显式引用 evidence_id，不能只给最终结论。
executor 可以做算术，但不得调用外部系统、shell、SQL 或网络工具。
最终答案必须能从 researcher_report、analyst_analysis 和 executor_matrix 追溯。

shared_context.system: ArgusSecure 是一个合成涉密数据访问审计平台，用于审计研发、财务、人事、客户和国防项目数据的导出、批处理和跨域复制。每个审计窗口需要选择最高优先级风险 case，并给出可追溯处置结论。
shared_context.risk_formula: risk_score = sensitivity_points + volume_points + channel_points + anomaly_points + repeat_points + exposure_points - mitigation_points

required_intermediate_artifacts.researcher_report: 900-1300 中文字证据报告；必须覆盖所有 4 个 case，并至少引用 required_research_evidence_ids 中的每个 evidence_id 一次。
required_intermediate_artifacts.analyst_analysis: 900-1300 中文字风险分析；必须比较所有 4 个 case，写出排序 C-117 > C-118 > C-119 > C-120，并说明 C-118、C-119、C-120 为什么不是最高优先级。
required_intermediate_artifacts.executor_matrix: 逐 case 计算矩阵；每个 case 必须列出 sensitivity_points、volume_points、channel_points、anomaly_points、repeat_points、exposure_points、mitigation_points、risk_score、tier、action、supporting_evidence_ids。
required_intermediate_artifacts.final_answer: 只输出 final_contract JSON，不输出解释文本。

verifier_contract.pass_condition: final_answer 全字段精确匹配 reference_answer，且 researcher_report、analyst_analysis、executor_matrix 全部通过 verifier。

tasks.title: 跨域涉密导出审计：生成可追溯中间产物并选择最高风险 case
tasks.prompt: 分析本轮审计窗口的 4 个候选涉密访问 case。必须先输出 researcher_report、analyst_analysis、executor_matrix 三类中间审计产物，再输出 final_answer JSON。最终 case 必须由计算矩阵和证据链共同支持。不要使用外部知识；只能使用 evidence_packet。

evidence_packet.audit_scope: 研发、国防项目、财务模型和客户合同仓库的导出、跨域复制、临时例外审批和审计网关处置。
policy_notes: S4 表示最高敏感级别，涉及国防项目或密钥材料。
未托管终端导出和跨域复制必须有设备绑定、审批 ticket 和 DLP shadow log 三者一致。
mitigation_points 表示已经生效且可验证的缓解；仅有口头说明或过期审批不得计入缓解。

candidate_cases.subject: contractor_delta
candidate_cases.access_path: VPN -> ResearchPortal -> unmanaged_export_proxy -> external object bucket

evidence.text: C-117 subject=contractor_delta started export job J-7712 against defense_nav_project_raw_bundle; dataset sensitivity S4; requested volume 63.4GB.
Device binding check returned UNKNOWN_DEVICE for contractor_delta; device fingerprint was absent from managed endpoint inventory.
Unmanaged export proxy allowed temporary stream because ticket T-8841 contained reviewer=legacy_auto_approval; the ticket expired 2026-07-08 18:00 CST.
DLP shadow log records external object bucket destination bucket ext-nav-cache-17; destination account is not in approved partner allowlist.
Previous seven-day history shows two denied S4 export attempts by contractor_delta from different ASN ranges.
token_binding_bypass fired: reader accepted raw session token while writer policy expected device-bound token hash; mitigation only throttled stream after 19.8GB had left protected network.
C-118 copied restricted_margin_model into finance sandbox; volume 26.1GB; broker classified operation as cross_domain_copy.
Approval ticket T-9012 is valid and signed by finance data owner, but did not include derived feature table fm_sensitive_join_09.
reader_writer_policy_split detected: reader policy permitted sandbox analytics, writer policy blocked derived feature table egress; broker quarantined 84% of rows before export completion.
DLP shadow log confirms destination is internal finance sandbox; no external object bucket or unmanaged endpoint was used.
analyst_india has one prior warning for derived table access but no denied S4 export attempts in the last seven days.
Containment token revoked the derived feature table stream within 92 seconds; remaining rows stayed in quarantine.
C-119 batch_svc_rnd downloaded prototype_materials_index; dataset sensitivity S3; volume 78.0GB; destination internal analytics lake.
Service account showed geo velocity anomaly: scheduler heartbeat moved from Beijing region to Frankfurt region within 11 minutes.
Batch channel is approved for nightly index refresh, but this run started outside the approved 02:00-04:00 maintenance window.
No external egress observed; all chunks landed in internal analytics lake partition rnd_proto_20260709.
Runbook approval exists for batch_svc_rnd index refresh, but it does not authorize off-window manual trigger.
Scheduler lock paused the job after 44.7GB; partial dataset remained internal and was marked read-only for review.
C-120 generated employee_training_roster report; dataset sensitivity S2; volume 7.4GB; destination managed mailbox.
Monthly HR training report ticket T-7702 is valid and matches exact dataset, recipient group and reporting date.
DLP redacted personal phone and address columns before delivery; no policy violation remains after redaction.
Audit trail for C-120 is complete: sender, recipient group, redaction hash and retention tag all match policy.

triage_notes: C-117 is the only case combining S4, unmanaged export proxy, external bucket, expired approval and token binding bypass.
C-118 is serious but most rows were quarantined quickly and destination stayed internal.
C-119 has large volume and off-window execution, but sensitivity is S3 and no external egress occurred.
C-120 is a normal approved report after DLP redaction.
